name: vdamage-driver
note: Weapon damage reaches an EMPTY vehicle. Pinned spawn 3,5 on Dustbowl puts the driver about 3 m from vehicle 9 at yaw ~6 degrees. Walk there before the bots are released (30 s after the first player body), stay OUT of the vehicle, and fire the pinned launcher (run with -Gear "BEU AW1") into its side. Grade vehicle 9's health on every client: before the 2026-09-23 fix an empty vehicle ignored all weapon damage on a server, so health stayed 1.0.
